text:
Anna: I pushed a concise draft of the release notes for the caching + batching defaults change and the Dedicated canary UX. Need a fast sweep for: known issues, SDK snippets (py/js/ruby), and the Private migration blurb before we publish tomorrow AM.

Praveen: Drop the draft link?

Anna: https://docs.redwood.ai/drafts/cache-batching-defaults-2026 (WIP)

Sam: I'll review snippets. Prefer v1-style examples by default and small v0.9 compatibility notes. For streaming show `stream=true` and `cache: { kv_enabled: true }`.

Lina: I'll add the Private migration checklist: config key rename (`kv_cache.enabled` -> `cache.kv_enabled`), helm override example, and a warmup curl to prime pinned variants after rolling updates. Also add an ops opt-out one-liner.

Praveen: Add a Known Issue about tokenization diffs with some 4-bit quant kernels on very long contexts (rare). Include mitigation steps: run sensitive evals on full-precision, re-tokenize with model vocab, or enable per-request tolerance. Link to eval artifacts. Mark any numeric bench as internal-only.

Sam: Draft Python snippet (v1):
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="REDACTED")
resp = client.generate(
  model="redwood-optim-1",
  input="Summarize the change",
  stream=True,
  options={"cache": {"kv_enabled": True}, "batch": {"max_tokens": 512}}
)
for chunk in resp.stream():
  print(chunk.text)
```
I'll add JS and a short Ruby sync example.

Lina: Warmup curl (draft):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://internal-infer.example/api/warmup" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-optim-1","variant":"pinned"}'
```
And ops opt-out: `cache.kv_enabled=false` in the deployment spec. Helm example: `helm upgrade --reuse-values --set cache.kv_enabled=false redwood-inference ./chart`.

Praveen: Also add a short fallback note for Dedicated: how to opt back to previous model variant routing if the canary shows regressions. One-liner CLI and console path would help.

Anna: docs-bot: please schedule a dry-run with linkcheck + snippet linter tomorrow 2026-03-24T18:30:00Z.

docs-bot: Dry-run scheduled for 2026-03-24T18:30:00Z. Snippet linter and linkcheck queued.

Sam: Small editorial nit: marketing/legal prefer qualitative phrasing publicly 1 avoid percent claims. We'll say "measurable per-route latency and cost improvements" and keep internal bench numbers in the product notes.

Lina: One more Known Issue to add: Private customers who pin variants may observe prefix cache misses after a worker restart; workaround is to run the warmup job or a small rolling restart to prime the KV shards. I'll draft the warmup and a kubectl one-liner: `kubectl -n redwood rollout restart deploy/inference-worker`.

Praveen: Once the linter finishes, aim to merge by EOD. If any blocking link/anchor problems, ping me immediately.

Anna: Thanks all   flipping to "ready for review" after Lina's migration blurb and Sam's JS/Ruby snippets land. :thumbsup:
